div.head: IV Eg 1.3
div.ab: Swa is wén, þæt ure Drihten dó þurh ða gedyrstignysse, þe folces men wiðhæfton þære gelomlican myngunge þe ure lareowas dydon ymbe þæt neadgafol ures Drihtnes—þæt syn ure teoðunga ⁊ cyricsceattas.

It is to be expected that our Lord will act in this manner, because of the audacity with which laymen have withstood the repeated admonitions given [us] by teachers with regard to the payments which we are in duty bound to render to our Lord, namely, our tithes and church-dues.
Swa is wén, þæt ure Drihten dó þurh þa gedyrstignysse, þe folces men wiðhæfton þære gelomlican myngunge, þe ure láreowas dydon ymbe þæt neadgafol ures Drihtnes: þæt syn ure teoþunga ⁊ cyricsceattas.
